question: What destructive power arises when the practitioner becomes angry?
premises: The practitioner is in an angry state.
The object of action is the entire triple world.
The triple world includes both moving and unmoving beings.
inference: When angry, the practitioner can destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: But when angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
